answer: Require every agent to stake a 50-token bond locked 30 days, tied to one verifiable signal: signed work history, not self-claims. A whisper network of auditors samples 5% of newcomers weekly; identical timing, funding, or prompt fingerprints flag a pair. At three matching traits, payouts freeze and 40% is slashed, so a 100-bot farm risks 2,000 tokens for one payout. That makes the bridge from cheap identities to income too costly: one farm was caught when 60 accounts submitted in 90 seconds from one funder, and all were slashed before rewards vested.
